corruptSays.line: The stash count is off. 1 stone missing. Nobody saw anything. Everybody suspects something.
The stash count is off. 1 stick missing. Nobody saw anything. Everybody suspects something.
The stash count is off. 1 plant fiber missing. Nobody saw anything. Everybody suspects something.

The man in his 40s, with a farmer's tan looks at the pantry, then at the Codex, then at you. "We’re going to make it." Haven will survive — because someone learned the land, and wrote it down. One less thing to fear.
Word reaches you, days late: Alejandra stands accused over what happened to Liam. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.

◈ FLASHBACK — Hoodie
Dorm laundry and rain. The night the storm took the power you walked three miles home in this, soaked through, laughing. Armor, basically.

◈ FLASHBACK — Trail compass
Lost above the fog line, visibility down to your boots. You didn't panic — just held the compass flat, found north, and walked out like it was nothing. It was not nothing.

◈ FLASHBACK — Field suture kit
You practiced on an orange. 'People are just oranges that bleed,' your instructor said, and then taught you how to not flinch. You haven't flinched since.

◈ FLASHBACK — Brass Locket
Brass. Two photos inside, both fading. It opens with a click you can feel in your teeth — Nora's click, then your mother's, now yours.
Liam has been talking at the fires. Enough voices — tonight they call a moot. Alejandra answers for what happened to Liam.
Liam calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
The moot turns to you. Your vote matters here — and everyone will remember it.

Farid leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about Hushpuppy. Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hushpuppy: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

FLASHBACK — before the scattering, there was an incident. People who knew you then use careful words about it now. You remember it differently than they do. You remember it clearly.
People will notice: smiles a beat too long when someone gets hurt. Let them. It's useful, being underestimated — or feared.

INNER VOICE: the others are already afraid. Fear is a kind of respect that doesn't ask for anything back. You could build something here — not on trust. On what people will do to stay on your good side. (Corruption starts at 20. The slope is yours to walk — or not.)
